rationale: High-information prospective extension of the currently valid C006 gap-reversion family into the accepted broker-native V6 frontier. The identity tests whether large observed reopening/session gaps mean-revert across asset classes while preserving live-equivalent admission, gap-safe executable settlement, fixed pre-outcome parameters, and the unchanged conservative cost authority. It does not tune to Wave05 candidate PnL and does not use protected-forward evidence.

features.name: observed_gap_minutes
features.formula: minutes between the current observed M5 bar open and the immediately previous observed M5 bar open

features.name: gap_return
features.formula: current observed M5 open / immediately previous observed M5 close - 1

features.name: prior_contiguous_abs_return_scale
features.formula: median of the 288 most recent absolute close-to-close returns whose adjacent observed M5 timestamps were exactly 5 minutes apart; only values completed before the current signal bar are eligible

direction.SHORT: gap_return > 0 under the same scale and cost hurdles

entry.price: first later observed M5 open after the completed signal bar; signal admission never queries whether that future open exists

exit.price: first observed M5 open at or after entry_timestamp_plus_60_minutes
exit.missing_target_within_market_closure: wait until first later observed M5 open, matching live executable semantics

execution_assumptions.missing_bars: market-closure gaps are preserved; no synthetic or forward-filled prices

cost_state.rule: Use the unchanged prospectively frozen candidate-independent V6 per-symbol roundtrip cost fraction; no C031 outcome calibrates cost.

causal_availability.decision_uses: current completed signal bar plus rolling state containing only earlier exact-M5 returns
causal_availability.entry_uses: pending intent filled only when the first later observed M5 open actually arrives
causal_availability.exit_uses: scheduled target created at entry; filled only when an observed M5 open at or after target arrives
causal_availability.training_or_normalization: rolling median uses only prior exact-M5 close-to-close returns and is snapshotted before current-bar update
causal_availability.sample_end: unfilled pending entry or open trade at capture end is right-censored and never retroactively changes admission
